I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the settled count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 261 seats.

- **Source:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Nobody has posted anything that changes it since.
- **Older figure:** The channel also shows 185 seats from August 2025. That was the count under the earlier Amendment No. 1, after Dana corrected her own 180, so it isn't the renewal number.

Dana is a member of #north-team, so she could already see all of this. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
